definitions.short: an angle (of a street or wall)
definitions.full: H6434. pen מִּנָּה 28 noun feminine corner ; — absolute ׳פ 2Kin 14:13 +, construct מִּנַּת Jer 31:40 +; suffix מִּנָּתָהּ Job 38:9 , מִּנָּהּ Prov 7:8 (Ges § 91e ); plural מִּנּוֺת absolute Zeph 1:16 ; 2Chr 26:15 , מִּנִּים Zech 14:10 ; construct מִּנּוֺת 1Kin 7:34 +, etc.; — 1. a. corner , of square objects 1Kin 7:34 + 7:30 (read מִּנּוֺתָיו for מַּעֲמֹתָיו , compare Kit), Exod 27:2 ; 38:2 ; Ezek 43:19 ; of house Job 1:19 , roof Prov 7:12 ; 21:9 = 25:24 ; לְפ ׳אֶבֶן Jer 51:26 i.e. a corner-stone; פ ׳אֶבֶן of earth Job 38:9 ; compare (figurative) Psa 118:22 , and ( אבן omitted) Isa 28:16 ; ׳פ = street-corner 2Chr 28:24 . b. specifically of wall of Jerusalem , Neh 3:24 (in southeast), 3:31 ; 3:32 (northeast); הַמּ ׳שַׁעַד 2Kin 14:13 + || 2Chr 25:23 ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 and most (for ׳שׁ הַמּוֺנֶה ᵑ0 ), + (see שַׁעַר ); apparently with battlements 26:15 ; of cities in General ׳הַמּ הַנְּבֹהוֺת Zeph 1:16 ; of the nations 3:6 . 2 figurative of chief, ruler as corner (support or defence), Judg 20:2 ; 1Sam 14:38 ; Isa 19:13 (read perhaps plural); Zech 10:4 (+ יָתֵד q. v.).
